jobs.title: UI/UX Designer - Beach Bum
jobs.description: ABOUT BEACH BUM Beach Bum is a dynamic and innovative gaming company that brings a fresh twist to classic games by introducing them to the world of casual online games. Beach Bum was created in 2015 by industry leaders out of a genuine passion for gaming and technology. In 2021, Beach Bum was acquired by hyper casual gaming leader Voodoo, opening the door to countless new opportunities and millions of players worldwide! ROLE OVERVIEW We're looking for a talented and driven UI/UX Designer to join our Product Art & Design team. You'll help shape the look and feel of one of our flagship mobile gaming experiences, taking creative ownership of features and events that millions of players interact with every day. Working closely with Product, Development, and Art, you'll own the user experience, visual concepts, and game UI that bring new features to life. You'll play a key role in creating intuitive, engaging, and visually compelling experiences that keep players coming back. RESPONSIBILITIES - Take full creative ownership of features and live events that millions of players engage with - Work closely with Product Managers, developers, and artists to understand feature mechanics and requirements and turn them into clear, polished design - Design fun, intuitive, pixel‑perfect interfaces that are consistent with the game's art style and tone - Build and maintain UX flows, layouts, and reusable UI components - from first concept through final delivery - Share and discuss UX/UI solutions with the team to push forward the game's visual language and design quality REQUIREMENTS - 2+ years designing UI/UX for mobile games - features and live events - An impressive portfolio demonstrating: - Excellent UI craft, creativity, and strong attention to detail - Flows and layouts with pixel‑perfect execution - Feature design including logos, icons, and UI panels - Solid command of color theory, composition, typography, layout design, and UI animation - Expert in Figma - components, variants, auto‑layout, prototyping, and working within a shared design system - Expert in Photoshop - layer comps, smart objects, non‑destructive editing with adjustment layers and masks, layer styles, and clean asset export - Openness to adopting new tools and AI‑assisted design workflows ADVANTAGE - Hands‑on experience using AI tools in the design workflow (generative image and ideation tools such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) and eagerness to work within an AI‑assisted design pipeline - Experience designing for social, multiplayer, or live‑ops‑driven games - Motion / UI animation skills (After Effects or equivalent) - Experience in working with Unity - Animation and Sfx guidance would be a plus BENEFITS - Cibus meal card with a monthly allowance of ILS 1,000 - Sick leave starting from the first day of employment - Half-day off on select holiday eves, in addition to statutory and contractual entitlements - An extra vacation day accrued for each year of employment - Company shuttle service from Tel Aviv, Ramat Gan, Givatayim, and Herzliya - Study fund (Keren Hishtalmut) starting from the first day of employment

jobs.title: 2D/Concept Artist - Beach Bum
jobs.description: ABOUT BEACH BUM Beach Bum is a dynamic and innovative gaming company that brings a fresh twist to classic games by introducing them to the world of casual online games. Beach Bum was created in 2015 by industry leaders out of a genuine passion for gaming and technology. In 2021, Beach Bum was acquired by hyper casual gaming leader Voodoo, opening the door to countless new opportunities and millions of players worldwide! ROLE OVERVIEW We're looking for a talented and driven 2D Artist / Concept Artist to join our Product Art & Design team. You'll help shape the look and feel of Lord of the Board, taking creative ownership of features and events that millions of players interact with every day. Working closely with Product and Monetization teams, you'll own the user experience, visual concepts, and game UI that bring new features to life. RESPONSIBILITIES With this role, you will be core to the company by contributing daily to important decisions with a multidisciplinary team of passionate and talented people. Flesh out the details of a game's design, oversee its testing, and revise the game in response to player feedback. Thanks to your creativity and your teamwork, let’s entertain millions of people with your hit games. Our studios are looking for people who bring their own ideas and are always willing to compromise to move forward. - Design and implement a high-quality, scalable UI from concept to final integration in Unity. - Create high-quality 2D assets (characters, assets, props and environment art) and ensure optimal performance across mobile devices. - Iterate quickly based on team feedback and live user data. - Propose creative ideas to boost player engagement and improve the user experience. - Create quick creative concepts, sketches, story telling - Take art project from early drafts to final polish and prepare the assets for animation and dev PROFILE - Excellent 2D design skills, with a keen eye for visual hierarchy, composition, and readability. - Good UI experience - A keen eye for emerging mobile game trends with the ability to creatively deconstruct and learn from success cases. - Experience collaborating with cross-functional remote teams. - Fluent in English. - Being able to setup and integrate scenes in Unity would be a plus - Figma knowledge would be an advantage BENEFITS - Cibus meal card with a monthly allowance of ILS 1,000 - Sick leave starting from the first day of employment - Half-day off on select holiday eves, in addition to statutory and contractual entitlements - An extra vacation day accrued for each year of employment - Company shuttle service from Tel Aviv, Ramat Gan, Givatayim, and Herzliya - Study fund (Keren Hishtalmut) starting from the first day of employment
